# Garden Log

## Tomatoes

Planted six Gardener's Delight seedlings on 10 May against the south fence. Pinched out side shoots every few days. First ripe tomato on 28 July. Next year try San Marzano for sauce.

## Compost

Turned the compost bin every two weeks. The heap got hot, around 55 C, after I added grass clippings and coffee grounds. Ready to use by September.

## The oak

The old oak at the end of the street is probably 200 years old according to the council tree officer. I started reading about it after [[The Overstory]].
